input: Original PNGs supplied by the player. Paired sheets show S on the left and A on the right; white sheets show S+. The barracks is authored separately.

operators.hammer: muscular bearded heavy, dark goggles, ear defenders, tank backpack; the grade-specific rocket launcher rests ON TOP of his shoulder throughout: rear tube extends BEHIND shoulder, centerline next to cheek, front projects past face. Entire silhouette reads a shoulder cannon even in downsights. Both hands attach below tube.
operators.raven: athletic ponytailed woman, red scarf, both distinct pistols, same face
operators.lynx: masked hooded sniper, same cloak hem, same scoped rifle
operators.cct: radio operator, same rank-specific aerial and pack, masked face, Korean sleeve patch and rifle
operators.bulk: sealed broad shield operator, same helmet visor and illustrated shield surface and outline. A black and yellow shield; S steel dark blue, red armor; S+ cyan hex shield and white armor.

ranks.C: Use character in the FIRST reference row (A) as exact face/equipment/scale template, with plain matte khaki brown/dark graphite cloth and subdued surplus metal. Modest entry-grade kit.
ranks.B: Use character in FIRST row (A) as exact face/equipment/scale template in olive green cloth, graphite plates, muted olive fittings. Keep identity.
ranks.A: COPY ONLY FIRST ROW of reference EXACTLY. Gold yellow and black. Same face, weapons, silhouette, colors, finish.
ranks.S: COPY ONLY SECOND ROW of reference EXACTLY. Crimson and black, same face, weapon, silhouette, colors and finish.
ranks.S-plus: COPY ONLY THIRD/BOTTOM ROW of reference EXACTLY. Ivory white, cyan parts and signature accents as pictured. Preserve ALL personalized details.

actions.aim: Five rows: 1 steep upward aiming toward 1 o'clock; 2 aim diagonal up-right by 42 degrees; 3 gun level horizontally right; 4 aim diagonally down-right 42 degrees; 5 steep down-right by 72 degrees. Each row shows SIX complete right-facing full-body moving-while-aiming poses with the SAME weapon angle throughout that row and SIX clearly DIFFERENT sequential footfalls (right lead/contact, right weight transfer, left foot passing, opposite lead, opposite weight transfer, right foot passing). Column 1 planted/braced. Torso, head size and height steady. No discharge effects. IMPORTANT camera view changes with aim: steep up row is rear three-quarter, firing toward the far/back of the screen with pack visible, diagonal up is rear/side three-quarter, horizontal is exact side view, diagonal down is side/front three-quarter, steep down is front three-quarter firing toward the viewer and into lower half of screen. Draw the left-facing counterparts implicitly by horizontal mirror; base figures aim right. All feet firmly grounded; modest weight shift.
actions.move: Five rows: 1 subtle six-frame standing guard breathing, BOOTS still; 2 side-on walking right, six distinctly different sequential footfalls; 3 walking three-quarter toward viewer, visible face/front equipment, six footfalls; 4 walking three-quarter away, show back of helmet and backpack, six footfalls; 5 six consecutive SPECIAL poses for the same soldier: {skill}. Keep torso quiet and scale consistent; no ground or environmental effects.

specials.hammer: kneel with the shoulder rocket launcher, lower for support and rise with tube mounted against shoulder, hands beneath
specials.raven: a six-pose dancer-like spin firing both pistols, side/back/front, ponytail and scarf follow naturally, both pistols visible
specials.bulk: stand, hunch, lower, kneel behind shield, crouch then full low cover
specials.cct: lift a hand to radio headset, call, acknowledge, return to rifle
specials.lynx: plant feet, lift rifle, sight level, brace, recoil lightly and settle

uniformTemplate: (role,tier,part)=>`Identity-preserving edit. Make a clean professional video-game animation sprite atlas for one character and ONE uniform ONLY, on true transparent RGBA background. Use the reference art as model sheet: ${roles[role]} ${tiers[tier]} Maintain the exact reference semi-realistic hand painted side-scroller ink outlines, anatomy, face, headgear, weapon silhouette, contrast and materials. No redesigns. Layout precisely FIVE horizontal rows by SIX evenly spaced columns of 30 full-body figures total, separate transparent gutters, entire feet head gear and weapon always inside its cell. No frames, numerals, labels, swatches, guides, smoke, floor or shadows. ${poses[part].replace('{skill}',skills[role])} Canvas large nearly square, tight framing per cell, transparent margins so no individual sprites touch. Each figure is individually drawn head to boots, consistent face across all 30.`
raisedHammer: Edit the supplied model. Produce a transparent game sprite sheet of THIS SAME SINGLE BEARDED HAMMER OPERATOR. Do not change the height of the weapon on the body: the long tube is carried ABOVE the shoulder, blocked jaw/lower-face behind the tube, tube bottom level with chin, rear extending at least one helmet width BEHIND the helmet, two raised forearms with hands at face height below it. This high carried position must be unmistakable in EVERY FRAME AND EVERY ANGLE. Upper rim near goggles; backpack low and separately visible. Trace the reference face, engraved sci-fi launcher, shoulder armor, proportions, colours and materials. Only vary limbs, view and aim direction as required. FIVE rows by SIX columns, exactly 30 figures, centered on uniform grid, separate clean transparent gutters, full boots, no shadows, no text or FX. All SIX frames in a row are individually drawn successive animation, camera depth as asked.

compass.zenith: FAR NORTH / REAR. The camera sees the BACK of the character's head and mostly the BACKPACK. Enemy directly behind them at the top edge of a top-down playfield. Nose and face hidden. Project the weapon toward the top of the picture with short foreshortening; its muzzle visible just beyond the near shoulder or to its right. All figures face AWAY from viewer. Absolutely no flat side profiles or faces looking right.
compass.up: NORTHEAST. BACK three-quarter view, viewer sees back and rear-right profile; enemy at upper right on screen. Raised barrel clearly projects to upper right, shoulder braced, weapon and pointed muzzle drawn on 42-degree upward-right screen diagonal. Distinct silhouette from side-on level shot. Barrel tip clearly above eyes.
compass.down: SOUTHEAST. FRONT three-quarter view aiming diagonally down and right toward viewer in an oblique top-down arcade field. See chest and face rather than side view. Show open end of weapon at the forward right. Muzzle lands close to lower ribs, angled roughly 40 degrees below horizontal on screen. Foreshorten the weapon as it comes toward viewer.
compass.nadir: SOUTH / TOWARD VIEWER. FACE-ON or extremely slight 10 degree three-quarter facing the camera. Enemy directly below the actor on the screen. Show front armor and face, both legs, foreshortened gun pointing OUT OF THE SCREEN and down along screen Y. Front bore faces viewer as a circular/oval shape. No sideways side-profile figures. Muzzle projects in front of the character near mid-torso. Back of weapon rests high.

compassLayout: EXACTLY FIVE rows and SIX columns. Each ROW holds a SINGLE costume. Row 1 C matte khaki and graphite; row 2 B olive green; row 3 A in original yellow and black; row 4 S original red and black; row 5 S+ original ivory and cyan, retain red scarf/cloak ONLY where present in the reference. All six columns per row depict six successive different walking-while-aiming footfalls. Keep head level and muzzle planted, alternate boots and knee bend. The FIRST column is braced. All 30 figures in SAME camera angle. No ground, shadows, flashes, words, spacing guides or labels.
compassTemplate: (role,dir)=>`Paint ONE camera bearing for a mobile game sprite atlas. CAMERA / TARGET RELATION IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: ${dirs[dir]} Identity and kit reference: ${role==='hammer'?'the supplied five-grade master from left to right. Always seat the launcher ON TOP of the shoulder beside the cheek. The rear of the cannon protrudes behind the helmet; elbows and hands high. For rear-facing frames see rear end, for front-facing frames see muzzle. Pivot the prop at shoulder height to the requested aim direction.':roles[role]+'; source has A on top, S middle, S+ bottom. Keep all illustrated gear and realistic outline style.'} ${tierRows} True transparent cutouts, spacing and full silhouettes in EVERY cell. Do not imitate the camera angle of the reference: orbit the camera to the requested bearing.`
ravenTurn: Identity-preserving game sprite repaint. Input 1 is an EXACT POSITION AND TIMING TEMPLATE: the 32 poses must match it cell for cell, including every boot, wrist and gun-tip XY, direction, bent knee and turn. Eight columns, four rows, transparent canvas. Input 2 is the official Raven visual and equipment costume sheet. Repaint EVERY one of the first input figures to use ONE consistent outfit for the whole sheet. Keep volume and face fixed, always her two original pistols, flowing red scarf and long dark ponytail. No text, FX or ground. All figures separated and every silhouette whole. Use this uniform from input 2:
ravenFollow: Identity-preserving repaint for game animation, respecting all original silhouettes. Input 1 is a strict pose and timing template of EXACTLY NINE horizontal rows by EIGHT columns. Each of its 72 full human figures is a separate frame of a 3-part follow-through. Trace every specific individual pose in the SAME CELL with the same directions of her arms/legs/pistols and same scale and boot line. Input 2 is the definitive visual model for the ONE Raven uniform throughout the output. Use reference ponytail, facial identity, flowing red scarf and two distinct pistols with no flashes or FX. All 72 fully visible separated figures on a transparent background. No text or shadows, no empty cells.
